propositions: A failed identity write after create_issue succeeds causes the freshly created Jira issue to be deleted and the error re-raised, destroying recoverable work.

The rollback deletes the issue but never unbinds the keyed-pending binding, leaving it pointing at a deleted Jira key so recover_pending re-attempts a doomed add_label forever and the ticket never syncs again.

The screen-error trigger arises in multiple cases (field not on Create/Edit screen, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property, or malformed value on a present field) and the Jira message is misleading about half the time.
The fix is subtractive: stop calling delete_issue, leave the binding keyed-pending, and let recover_pending's deterministic no-search retro-attach complete the label and entity property.
rebar should declare that labels must be on the project's Create and Edit screens rather than implement createmeta-driven pre-flight field discovery, which is out of scope.

On permanent identity-write failures retro-attach will re-fail each pass, so whether not-deleting is preferable to a clean rollback is a design tradeoff between a stranded pending binding and lost created work that must be argued explicitly.
